subject: Leadership cadence & span adjustments — draft announcement and QBR prep
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Leadership cadence & span adjustments — draft announcement and QBR prep

Team —

I'm proposing a short set of leadership changes to improve our execution going into the Q1 QBR cycle and to make OKR ownership clearer across Product/Eng/SRE. High-level asks: review the attached one-pager and OKR mapping, flag anything you disagree with, and confirm owners by EOD Tuesday so we can lock slides for QBR prep.

Summary of proposed changes (attached: cadence-one-pager.pdf, okrs-mapping-draft.xlsx):
- Leadership cadence: move from monthly leadership forum to a biweekly 60m leadership sync (focused exec decisions) + monthly all-leads deep-dive for cross-functional OKR deep dives.
- Span-of-control adjustments: encourage managers to target ~6 direct reports where possible; shift a few high-load IC managers to lead-of-leads model for scale.
- OKR ownership: centralize cross-cutting OKRs under 1 program owner (product partner) + 1 technical sponsor (eng/SRE).
- Communications plan: soft manager briefing, followed by town hall for full org. Draft timeline below.

Initial timeline:
- Tue 12/15: leadership review complete (owners assigned)
- Mon 12/20: manager briefing (internal only)
- Tue 12/28: town hall (announce changes and QBR narrative)

Specific asks from each of you:
- Laura: review and confirm product-side program owners + talking points for town hall.
- Karthik: confirm technical sponsors for the Reliability & Throughput OKRs and any resource blockers.
- Hannah: advise on Sales/CS communication and timing; we want predictable customer messaging.
- Markus: help identify which teams need span adjustments (who's overloaded).

Notes: this is focused on execution and clarity; not a headcount reduction exercise. We will coordinate with People if any role moves require formal changes.

Thanks — please add edits directly in the drive doc or reply inline.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Platform & Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: cadence-one-pager.pdf (1 page), okrs-mapping-draft.xlsx (12 rows)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Leadership cadence & span adjustments — draft announcement and QBR prep

Vivek —

Thanks for this. I like the clarity and the focus on program owners. Two quick edits:
1) Add a one-page manager FAQ that addresses career-path questions and the process for spans-of-control changes (to reduce unexpected 1:1 escalations). I drafted a starter doc (attached).
2) For the town hall, let's include a 3-minute customer impact example (how this helps reliability and time-to-fix). I can draft a short script.

I also think we should delay the public town hall one week if the manager briefing uncovers major edge cases — gives us a buffer for questions from people managers. Suggestion: manager briefing on Monday 12/20, leadership final sign-off on 12/22, town hall on 12/29.

Putting a couple of inline comments in the OKR mapping doc.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Product
Redwood Inference

Attachment: town-hall-script-draft.md

Agree with framing. A few engineering-specific notes on the Reliability OKR:
- Proposed success metrics: API P95 latency, SLO breach frequency, mean time to restore (MTTR), and percentage of incidents with postmortem published within 72h.
- Recommend technical sponsor be the SRE lead + a product partner; Markus, are you able to be the technical sponsor for the first 90 days?
- If span-of-control changes imply re-orging squads, we should surface any hiring needs to People now — I have two teams that will push new lead requisitions if we tighten spans.

I'll add metric rows in the okrs-mapping sheet. Also flagged one possible dependency: scheduled canalization of inference runtime changes in Jan that could temporarily affect latency baselines.

Thanks for the quick turn. Based on your feedback I’m pushing a version we can sign off on this week. Attachments: leadership-announcement-final-v1.docx, qbr-slide-deck-outline.pptx. Key updates in this version:

- Owners: Customer Reliability OKR -> Product program owner: Laura Bennett; Technical sponsor: Markus Klein (SRE)
- Cadence: Biweekly Leadership Sync (Mon 60m) starting 01/04; Monthly All-Leads deep-dive on first Thursday of month starting 01/07
- Manager briefing: internal managers only on Mon 12/20 at 3pm PT (calendar invite to follow)
- Town hall: Tue 12/29 at 11am PT (Q&A after announcement; 45m total)
- Manager FAQ and Sales/CS one-pager included in drive (links below).

Next steps:
1) Please reply-all with one-line approval or a blocking concern by EOD Monday 12/21.
2) Laura and Hannah, please own the manager FAQ and Sales one-pager edits by Thu 12/17 (I know that's tight; if you need team support, tell me).
3) Karthik and Markus, finalize metric definitions in the OKR sheet; we'll snapshot those as our measurement plan for QBR slides.

If I don't get objections, I'll schedule the manager briefing and lock the town hall slide deck. Thanks for running with this — feels like a pragmatic set of changes that should improve clarity and velocity.

Vivek Kulkarni
